set.body: S1.5b discovered a reproducible pin628c46f issue: load a different/unknown pane type under an already attached pane id; Dock.reconcile reuses the prior binding, and withLiveState also replaces inactive perspective content solely by id. Unknown payload is lost at capture. Studio workaround detaches before restore to use the pin type-aware retained-view reattachment path and captures each perspective independently. LayoutPersistenceFxSuite unknown-type test was red before and green after, and requires an actual unresolved placeholder plus preserved payload. Reproduce/fix at the provider, then consider retiring the adapter workaround only after pin qualification. No provider source changed or message sent in this session.
set.title: Scaladock pin: preserve pane type on live restore and inactive-layout snapshots
